limitations: Three review calls with at most two concurrent, one proposal/digest, two screen revisions, one replaced path and one dispatch.

Real browser IndexedDB validates source/destination bytes across refresh, stale listings, stale identity reads and cancellation. Proposal transport and localStorage journal ports are fixtures and establish no server authorization or journal durability.

Native OS/storage authority, multiple paths/proposals, trash/deletion, browser restart and unbounded review sequences remain outside this projection. Progress assumes host callbacks settle with weak fairness.
